headline:
FIGHT ERUPTS INSIDE CINEMA
OVER SPIDER-MAN SPOILER CLAIM
VIDEO GOES VIRAL ONLINE
captionDraft:
A short video showing a scuffle inside a cinema has gone viral alongside claims that an argument began over alleged spoilers during a Spider-Man screening. The precise location, circumstances and cause of the confrontation have not been officially confirmed.

No reliable report or official authority has confirmed the viral claim that a death occurred. News18 reported that the authenticity of the claims accompanying the clip remains unverified and that there was no official confirmation regarding the exact circumstances or any formal complaint.

Credit: @0xMiraqle on X. Verification reference: News18. Visual: source clip retained as an unverified viral video; a generated illustrative image is also available for contextual use. Claims are based on publicly available reports at posting time and remain subject to correction.
